pins.title: Three days in the Smokies, planned
pins.sub: Hikes, drives and parking, with winter notes.
pins.pinTitle: Great Smoky Mountains 3-day itinerary: Alum Cave, Cades Cove and Charlies Bunion, with winter notes
pins.description: A simple 3-day Smokies plan: Alum Cave and Newfound Gap, Cades Cove with Abrams Falls, then Charlies Bunion or an easier waterfall. Distances as the NPS gives them, parking tag rules and what changes from late November to March. Always check nps.gov/grsm for current road status.

pins.title: Icy trail? Short steps, poles out.
pins.sub: See the guide: when you need spikes.
pins.pinTitle: How to hike on icy trails: short steps, trekking poles and when you need microspikes
pins.description: Early winter trails freeze where you least expect it. Take short, flat-footed steps, use trekking poles for balance and put traction on before you reach the ice. Our guide explains microspikes vs crampons vs snowshoes and when to turn back.

pins.title: Cold toes can end a winter hike
pins.sub: How to keep your feet warm all day.
pins.pinTitle: How to keep your feet warm on a winter hike: socks, boots, rest stops and toe warmers
pins.description: Cold feet on a winter hike usually come from damp socks, tight boots and a cold core. Our guide covers which socks and boots work, how to keep snow out, staying warm at rest stops, whether toe warmers help and when numb toes are a warning sign.

pins.title: Gift for someone who just started hiking
pins.sub: Guide, packing list and trip planner.
pins.pinTitle: Gift for a new hiker: beginner hiking guide, packing checklist and trip planner bundle
pins.description: Know someone who just caught the hiking bug? The Beginner Hiker Bundle has our Beginner's Hiking Guide, the packing checklist and a trip planner in one printable download. Instant PDF, easy to give by email.

pins.title: There are 64 national parks now
pins.sub: See the full list by state.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: How many national parks are there in the US? 64 now, with the full list by state
pins.description: Chiricahua in Arizona became the 64th US national park in October 2026, so lists that say 63 are out of date. See all 64 parks by state, which states have the most and what counts as a national park, with facts from nps.gov.

pins.title: A tiny trail journal for their stocking
pins.sub: Print it, fold it, gift it.
pins.pinTitle: Hiking stocking stuffer: a print-and-fold pocket trail journal for under $5
pins.description: A small gift for the hiker who has everything: the Pocket Trail Log prints on one sheet and folds into a mini trail journal for notes from every hike. Instant download, last-minute friendly stocking stuffer.

pins.title: Cozy toes on cold mornings
pins.sub: Merino socks for camp, cabin and couch.
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks for cold mornings: warm, cushioned crew socks for camp, cabin and home
pins.description: Cold tent floors, chilly cabins and early mornings at home: merino socks stay warm and soft. Ours are 80% merino as labelled, cushioned, crew height, in four colours. Sold as one pair.

pins.title: The socks you will wear all winter
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool crew socks for winter: dog walks, commutes, ski trips and weekend hikes
pins.description: Warm, cushioned merino socks for every cold day: dog walks, the commute, ski trips, outdoor games and weekend hikes. 80% merino as labelled, crew height, four colours, sold as one pair. A practical gift too.

pins.title: Every hiking guide, in one gift
pins.pinTitle: Ultimate hiker's toolkit printable: 7 hiking guides bundle for beginners, solo and safety
pins.description: Seven printable hiking guides in one download: beginner and solo hiking guides, a trip planner, a packing checklist, a safety guide, an emergency checklist and what to do if you get lost. A big gift for a hiker who likes to be prepared.

pins.title: Planning Yellowstone and Grand Teton?
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Yellowstone and Grand Teton trip planner printable: 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries and beginner hikes
pins.description: Planning a first trip to Yellowstone and Grand Teton? This printable guide covers when to go, what to book and when, sample 3, 5 and 7-day plans and the best beginner day hikes in both parks. Always check nps.gov for current conditions.
